# dacode-dm-csv-031

## Instruction
Identify the users who made the last 6 pull requests for the specific file "src/compiler/scala/reflect/reify/phases/Calculate.scala".

## About Dataset
The dataset contains GitHub pull request history of the Scala language. It includes two main CSV files:
- `pulls.csv`: Contains pull request information including PR ID, user, date, and title
- `pull_files.csv`: Contains the files associated with each pull request
